description: Positivnetz Lang-LKW Hamburg is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Mobilithek. Der Datensatz beinhaltet den Teil des Hamburger Straßennetzes, der für die Befahrung mit Lang-Lkw freigegeben ist (Positivnetz). In Hamburg beschränkt sich dieses Straßennetz auf die Bundesautobahnen für den Transit zwischen den Bundesländern, auf einige Strecken im Hafenbereich sowie auf ausgewählten Stadtstraßen zu Gewerbe- und Industriegebieten. Coverage: Mobilithek. The portal files it under the publisher Mobilithek. Its tags are bmvbs, feldversuch, geodaten, gigaliner, hvd. It offers 11 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/BIN, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/GML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support freight and delivery logistics studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
